validation_plan.need_source: Owner request and existing approved SEL need/plan
validation_plan.intended_use: Administrator can identify logging/capacity/access/native-clock issues, preserve evidence and intentionally enable safe qualified automation.
validation_plan.operating_context: Exact nine LTX inventory targets, direct and supported Fleet base paths, unchanged retention/credentials/other component pins

rater_profile.name_or_role: Hannes Zietsman or separately named owner-approved operations proxy
rater_profile.relationship_to_work: Deployment administrator responsible for LTX evidence and outcomes
rater_profile.independence_note: Not implementing agent; named proxy approval and role recorded before pass
rater_profile.representative_reason: Operates these exact machines and chooses automation outcomes

scenario_matrix.scenario: Operator identifies each exact LTX name/IP, independent capacity/logging and access blockers; raw clock interpretation unknown displayed honestly.
scenario_matrix.acceptance_signal: Independent fixed reads match displayed readings/reasons; no false five-hour correction or unsupported healthy status.

scenario_matrix.scenario: On accepted safe canary, operator inspects complete durable raw receipt then clear outcome.
scenario_matrix.acceptance_signal: Same-token conditional clear and ingress preservation independently accepted; saved history readable. Otherwise held, no forced test.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Operator inspects independently reopened raw SEL backup receipt, retained history and interrupted operation status.
scenario_matrix.acceptance_signal: History/audit/active receipt unchanged; unknown effect visibly held and no replay.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Current admin arms each accepted per-device policy through direct/Fleet UI; read roles cannot.
scenario_matrix.acceptance_signal: Independent toggles/revocation/rebinding work, unqualified action stays unavailable, no unsafe rendering.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Operator sees qualified BMC native correction only where needed and permitted by clock authority.
scenario_matrix.acceptance_signal: Trusted UTC/mapping/offset/readback plus vendor-justified interval pass; already-correct, managed or unknown clocks are not written.

deferred_gaps.trigger: Safe exact-device/action qualification and independent raw review
deferred_gaps.impact: Clear/clock action remains unavailable until its evidence passes

deferred_gaps.trigger: Actual approved deployment/operator session on exact candidate
deferred_gaps.impact: No operational acceptance or requirement closure before named rater evidence
